notes.title: New DX version to celebrate new game ChainStaff.
notes.notes:
I'm releasing all the DX content for free to players who already own the game!
This is to celebrate the reveal of my next game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/
https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2976260/header.jpg?t=1718126766https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2976260/header.jpg?t=1718126766
Please wishlist ChainStaff today! It's a big help to me, as it helps support me as I keep making new games. As a thank you--here's all the new DX content for Shoot 1UP!

Shoot 1UP DX has two brand new levels!
These are cool because now the game has proper branching levels.
The level structure is now like this:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10086854/7d5a977b1c0afcfccef3f1670224abdd147d2a26.png
Now it feels like it should, where as you make a decision to go a new direction, you'll find a whole new area!


 Two entirely new levels, a dozen new enemies and new bosses!
 The original levels now feature a few new enemies popping up!
 Remastered for 4K resolution at 60 fps a ridiculous amount of bullets!


Thank you for playing Shoot 1UP DX all of my Mommy's Best Games!

-Nathan
Mommy's Best Games
